collection.description: A storyteller proposes that a distant people might build a speaking figure and claim a spirit lives within it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At a night gathering, a storyteller proposes that a distant people might build a speaking figure and claim a spirit lives within it.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A devotee says spirits might inhabit fashioned things, but admits no one has witnessed such a figure.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Another villager fears that calling every strange mechanism sacred could hide an ordinary explanation.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A researcher proposes hidden cords, weights, and stored instructions, yet cannot explain imagined conversation.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The carver points out that describing how a thing moves would not settle whether it feels.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The gathering agrees that a mechanism and a spiritual interpretation need not answer the same question.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A skeptic objects that possibilities are not evidence; the debate ends without a verdict.
